items.title: Your AWS Security, Identity, and Governance guide to re:Invent 2026
items.summary: The AWS Security, Identity, and Governance team invites you to join us at re:Invent in Las Vegas from November 30 to December 4, 2026. You know all too well that AI agents now act on their own across the systems you run, and that changes what identity, detection, network protection, and governance have to cover. […]
items.creator: Brandon Carroll
